name: claude-desktop-mods
description: Claude Code mods for the Code tab and terminal: /handoff-to asks for a Markdown brief a session in another repository can act on, and a band copies any brief a reply holds or shows it in a pane; /context-view opens a pane showing what fills the session context (window, instructions loaded, Markdown read, a devbook lens) with a ctx status line entry; an account bar above the prompt shows the signed-in account and the weekly usage limit, so parallel instances are told apart. Writes nothing to disk. Claude-only.

accountLabel.title: Account label
accountLabel.description: Shown in the account bar instead of the email (e.g. Work, Private). Empty uses the email.

accountColor.title: Account colour
accountColor.description: The account bar's accent as #rrggbb. Empty derives a stable colour from the account.
